Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.accountInfo: Account information: Name, email address, password, phone number, location, and profile photo.
Privacy.listingData: Listing data: Photos, descriptions, prices, and other details you add to listings.
Privacy.messages: Messages: Content of messages sent through our platform.
Privacy.reviews: Reviews: Ratings and comments you leave for other users.
Privacy.usageData: Session data: the session token needed to keep you signed in, stored securely on your device.
Privacy.deviceInfo: Notification token: if you allow notifications, an identifier specific to your installation is stored so we can send the alerts you asked for.
Privacy.locationData: Location: only if you explicitly allow it, your approximate position is used to show listings near you. It is not derived from your IP address and is not stored on your profile.
Privacy.use1: Provide and maintain the Buy'N'Sellem platform
Privacy.use2: Enable communication between buyers and sellers
Privacy.use3: Display relevant listings and search results
Privacy.use5: Prevent fraud and enforce our terms of service
Privacy.use6: Send important updates about your account or transactions
Privacy.use7: Improve our platform based on usage patterns
Privacy.sharingIntro: We do not sell your personal information. We may share information with:
Privacy.share1: Other users: your public profile (name, avatar, city, rating) is visible. Your email address is never displayed. If you have verified your phone number and chosen to attach it to your listings, it can be revealed to interested buyers from the listing page.
Privacy.share2: Service providers: NotchPay processes boost payments made on the website. Our notification provider receives your account identifier in order to deliver alerts. Our SMS providers, AvlyText (avlytext.com) and MTarget (m-target.com), receive your number during verification.
Privacy.share3: Law enforcement: When required by law or to protect safety.
Privacy.securityDesc: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data, including encrypted connections (HTTPS), secure password hashing, and access controls. However, no system is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
Privacy.right1: Access your personal data through your profile and settings
Privacy.right2: Update your information at any time through the Settings page
Privacy.right3: Delete your account and associated data from Settings > Security in the mobile app, or from your account settings on the website.
Privacy.right4: Export your data by contacting our support team
Privacy.retentionDesc: We retain your data for as long as your account is active. When you delete your account, deletion is immediate and permanent: listings, photos, messages, conversations, favorites, reviews, saved searches and blocks are erased, and Sign in with Apple access is revoked where applicable. Some data may be retained if required by law (fraud prevention, legal disputes).
Privacy.childrenDesc: Buy'N'Sellem is not intended for use by anyone under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.
Privacy.thirdPartyDesc: Our platform may contain links to third-party websites or services. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of these external services. We encourage you to read their privacy policies.
Privacy.changesDesc: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes by email or through a notice on the platform. Your continued use of the Service after changes constitutes acceptance.
Privacy.contactDesc: For questions about this privacy policy or your data, contact us at {email}.
Privacy.mobileIntro: The mobile app requests the following permissions, each only at the moment you use the corresponding feature:
Privacy.mobilePhotos: Camera and photo library: to add photos to your listings and your profile. Photos are only uploaded when you select them.
Privacy.mobileLocation: Location: to show listings near you. Permission is never requested at launch, only when you turn this option on.
Privacy.mobilePush: Notifications: to alert you about new messages and activity on your listings.
Privacy.mobilePhone: Phone number: if you choose to verify it, a one-time code is sent to you by SMS. The code is stored hashed and expires after ten minutes.
Privacy.mobileSocial: Google, Apple or Facebook sign-in: we receive your name, email address and your identifier at the provider. For Apple, a refresh token is stored so we can revoke access if you delete your account.
Privacy.noTrackingDesc: We do not embed any analytics, advertising or third-party tracking SDK, and we do not use any advertising identifier. Your data is neither sold nor shared for advertising purposes.

Cookies.title: Cookie Policy
Cookies.whatAreDesc: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help the website remember your preferences, keep you logged in, and understand how you use the site.
Cookies.essentialDesc: These cookies are necessary for the platform to function. They enable core features like user authentication and security. You cannot opt out of essential cookies as the platform would not work without them.
Cookies.authCookie: Authentication cookie: Stores your login session so you don't need to log in on every page.
Cookies.localStorageDesc: In addition to cookies, we may use browser local storage for client-side preferences. This data never leaves your device and is not sent to our servers.
Cookies.managingDesc: You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to block or delete cookies. Note that blocking essential cookies will prevent you from logging in.
Cookies.chrome: Chrome: Settings > Privacy and Security > Cookies
Cookies.edge: Edge: Settings > Cookies and Site Permissions
Cookies.updatesDesc: If we add new types of cookies (e.g., analytics), we will update this policy and notify users. We are committed to minimal cookie usage and user privacy.
Cookies.contactDesc: Questions about our cookie policy? Contact us at {email}.

Help.title: Help Center
Help.subtitle: Everything you need to know about using Buy'N'Sellem
Help.gettingStartedDesc: Create your account and set up your profile
Help.sellingDesc: List items, manage listings, and get paid
Help.boostPaymentsDesc: Promote your listings for more visibility
Help.safetyDesc: Tips and guidelines to stay safe
Help.faq1q: How do I create an account?
Help.faq1a: Click the "Sign up" button in the top-right corner. Fill in your name, email, and a password. You'll be logged in immediately and can start browsing or selling.
Help.faq2q: How do I post a listing?
Help.faq2a: Once logged in, click the "Sell now" button. Follow the 4-step process: choose a category, add details and price, upload photos, then review and publish.
Help.faq3q: Is it free to list items?
Help.faq3a: Yes! Posting listings on Buy'N'Sellem is completely free. You can optionally boost your listing for more visibility with our paid promotion feature.
Help.faq4q: How does the boost feature work?
Help.faq4a: Boosting places your listing at the top of search results and marks it as "Featured". You can boost for 7, 14, or 30 days. Payment is handled securely through NotchPay.
Help.faq5q: How do I contact a seller?
Help.faq5a: On any listing page, click the "Message seller" button. This opens a direct conversation where you can negotiate and arrange the transaction.
Help.faq6q: How do I mark an item as sold?
Help.faq6a: Go to "My Listings" from your profile menu. Click the three-dot menu on the listing and select "Mark as sold".
Help.faq7q: Can I edit my listing after publishing?
Help.faq7a: Yes. Go to "My Listings", click "Edit" on the listing you want to change. You can update the title, price, description, photos, and category.
Help.faq8a: After a transaction, you can leave a review on the other user's profile page. Rate them from 1 to 5 stars and optionally leave a comment. Reviews help build trust in the community.
Help.supportTeam: Our support team is here for you.

Safety.title: Safety Tips
Safety.subtitle: Your safety is our priority. Follow these guidelines for a secure experience.
Safety.meetPublicDesc: Always arrange meetings in well-lit, busy public areas like shopping centers, police stations, or cafes. Avoid going to a stranger's home or inviting them to yours.
Safety.inspectBeforeDesc: Always check the item thoroughly before handing over any money. Test electronics, check for damage, and verify that it matches the listing description and photos.
Safety.neverAdvanceDesc: Legitimate sellers will not ask for payment before you've seen the item. Never wire money, send mobile money, or use gift cards as payment to someone you haven't met.
Safety.bringSomeoneDesc: When meeting for a transaction, especially for high-value items, bring a friend or family member along. Let someone know where you're going.
Safety.keepOnPlatformDesc: Use Buy'N'Sellem's built-in messaging to communicate with buyers and sellers. This helps us protect you and provides a record of your conversations.
Safety.trustInstinctsDesc: If a deal seems too good to be true, it probably is. If something feels wrong or a person makes you uncomfortable, walk away. Your safety is more important than any deal.
Safety.redFlag1: Seller asks for payment before meeting
Safety.redFlag2: Price is suspiciously low compared to market value
Safety.redFlag3: Seller refuses to meet in person
Safety.redFlag4: Seller asks you to pay via wire transfer or gift cards
Safety.redFlag5: Listing has stolen or stock photos
Safety.redFlag6: Seller pressures you to decide quickly
Safety.redFlag7: Seller asks for personal information (bank details, ID)
Safety.redFlag8: Communication moves off-platform to WhatsApp or email immediately
Safety.wrong1: Stop all communication with the person
Safety.wrong2: Do not send any more money or personal information
Safety.wrong3: Report the user or listing using the "Report" button
Safety.wrong4: Contact local authorities if you've been scammed
Safety.wrong5: Reach out to our support team for assistance
